title: Budget 2020: DDT scrapped, no LTCG relief
description: Dividend distribution tax removed (shifted to recipients); no LTCG cut. Sensex -2.43% to 39,735 on Budget day (a Saturday session).

title: OPEC+ pact collapses, Brent -30%; Yes Bank stress
description: Brent fell ~30% to ~$31 after the OPEC-Russia supply-cut pact broke down; Sensex -5.17% to 35,635, Nifty -538 pts to 10,451. Yes Bank crisis and FPI selling added to it.
notes: Confounded with Covid-19 onset.

title: Covid lockdown crash: 10% lower circuit
description: Sensex -13.15% to 25,981 (-3,935 pts), worst day ever; Nifty closed 7,610 (~-13%). Trading halted 45 min after lower circuit as districts went into lockdown.
notes: Category: no pandemic bucket in spec; mapped to geopolitics (see open questions).

title: Pfizer: vaccine >90% effective
description: Announced after Indian hours; Nov 10 Sensex +680 to 43,278 and Nifty +1.42% to 12,638, both at records. Bihar result and Biden win also cited.
notes: Positive node. Category mapped to geopolitics (no pandemic bucket).

title: Budget 2021: capex push, no new taxes
description: Infrastructure/capex-led stimulus with no Covid tax. Sensex +5.00% to 48,600 (+2,315 pts), Nifty +4.74% to 14,281, best day since Apr 2020.

title: Retrospective tax repealed (Taxation Laws Amendment Bill)
description: Bill introduced Aug 5 to nullify the 2012 retrospective indirect-transfer tax (Vodafone/Cairn disputes); passed Lok Sabha Aug 6 and Rajya Sabha Aug 9.

title: Omicron variant named; global risk-off
description: Week ended Nov 26: Sensex -4.24%, Nifty -4.16%. November was the worst month since Mar 2020, also driven by FII selling, crude and taper worries.
notes: Category mapped to geopolitics (no pandemic bucket). Confounded with taper worries.

title: Budget 2022: capex +35% to Rs 7.5 lakh cr; 30% crypto tax
description: Capex outlay raised 35.4% to Rs 7.5 lakh crore; crypto income taxed at 30%. Sensex +848 (+1.46%) to 58,862, Nifty +1.37% to 17,576.

title: Russia invades Ukraine
description: Nifty -4.78% to 16,248, Sensex -4.72% to 54,530; Brent above $105, rupee ~75.6.

title: Fed starts hiking: +25 bps
description: First Fed hike in three years, well telegraphed; Sensex +1.86% to 56,817 on Mar 16 and +1.8% on Mar 17.

title: RBI off-cycle repo hike to 4.40%
description: Off-cycle MPC (May 2-4) raised repo 40 bps to 4.40% (SDF 4.15%, MSF/Bank Rate 4.65%), unanimous; first hike since Aug 2018. Press also reports a 50 bps CRR hike to 4.5% (not confirmed in the excerpt retrieved).
notes: Primary RBI page. The other five hikes remain on a secondary source.

title: RBI hikes repo 50 bps to 4.90%
description: Second hike of the cycle.
notes: Dates/levels from one secondary page; upgrade to RBI press release before publishing.

title: Fed hikes 75 bps, largest since 1994
description: Jun 16: Sensex -1.99% to 51,496, Nifty -2.11% to 15,361, fifth straight fall; hike was widely expected.

title: RBI hikes repo 50 bps to 5.40%
description: Third hike of the cycle.
notes: Dates/levels from one secondary page; upgrade to RBI press release before publishing.

title: Powell's hawkish Jackson Hole speech
description: Aug 29: Sensex -861 to 57,973, Nifty IT -4%, rupee at record low ~79.96.
notes: Speech date (Fri Aug 26) taken from the lead-up report; confirm.

title: RBI hikes repo 50 bps to 5.90%
description: Fourth hike of the cycle.
notes: Dates/levels from one secondary page; upgrade to RBI press release before publishing.

title: US CPI 7.7%, below 8% expected
description: Fed-pivot hopes: Nov 11 Sensex +1.95% to 61,795 (record close), Nifty +1.78% to 18,350; rupee 80.78.
notes: Positive node.

title: RBI hikes repo to 6.25%
description: Fifth hike of the cycle.
notes: Dates/levels from one secondary page; upgrade to RBI press release before publishing.

title: Hindenburg report on Adani Group
description: Report on Jan 24; Jan 25 Sensex -774 to 60,205, Nifty -226 to 17,892; Adani group lost ~Rs 4.2 lakh crore m-cap by Jan 27.

title: Budget 2023: capex +33%, new tax regime default, CG tax untouched
description: Capex up 33% to Rs 10 lakh crore; rebate limit Rs 7 lakh in new regime. Sensex swung +2% intraday, closed +0.27% (59,708); Nifty -0.26%.
notes: One week after Hindenburg: confounded with the Adani episode.

title: RBI hikes repo 25 bps to 6.50%
description: Sixth and last hike; pause followed.
notes: Dates/levels from one secondary page; upgrade to RBI press release before publishing.

title: Silicon Valley Bank collapse
description: Mar 13: Sensex -897 to 58,238, Nifty -1.49% to 17,154, five-month lows; banks led.
notes: Failure date (Fri Mar 10) not stated in the source; weekend US backstop mentioned.

title: RBI pauses at 6.50% after six hikes
description: Ended the hike cycle ('a pause, not a pivot'); some had expected +25 bps. Sensex +143 to 59,833, Nifty +42 to 17,599, realty ~+3%.
notes: Sources disagree on whether the pause was a surprise.

title: Hamas attack on Israel; war begins
description: Oct 9: Sensex ~-483 to 65,512, Nifty ~-0.7% to 19,512; PSU banks -3%, India VIX +10-12%, Brent +4% to >$88.

title: BJP sweeps MP, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh
description: Dec 4: Sensex +2.05% to 68,865, Nifty +2.07% to 20,687, both at records; Bank Nifty record. Read as policy stability ahead of 2024.
notes: Positive node. Category mapped to geopolitics (no domestic-politics bucket). Also cites macro data and rate-cut bets.

title: HDFC Bank Q3 miss triggers index rout
description: Jan 17: Sensex -1,628 (-2.23%) to 71,501, worst day since Jun 2022; HDFC Bank -8.5% and ~60% of the fall.
notes: Results date (Jan 16) inferred as the day before the reaction; confirm.

title: India-Mauritius tax treaty protocol adds principal purpose test
description: Signed Mar 7, 2024: treaty benefits denied where obtaining them was a principal purpose of an arrangement; adds scrutiny of Mauritius-routed FPIs.
notes: No index reaction sourced; ratification/entry-into-force status not confirmed. Likely a weak signal.

title: SEBI-directed stress tests for small/mid-cap funds
description: AMCs required to run and disclose liquidity stress tests on small/mid-cap schemes from Mar 15, 2024.
notes: Index reaction not sourced (a Mar 13 crash was NOT found).

title: Lok Sabha results: BJP short of majority
description: Sensex -5.74% to 72,079, Nifty -5.93% to 21,885, worst day in four years; rebounded +3.2% next day.
notes: Category mapped to geopolitics (no domestic-politics bucket).

title: Budget 2024: angel tax abolished
description: Section 56(2)(viib) angel tax removed for all investor classes. Positive for startups; no index reaction sourced.
notes: Same-day Budget cluster. Announcement only; enactment not checked.

title: Budget 2024: buyback taxed as dividend
description: From Oct 1, 2024 buyback proceeds taxed in shareholders' hands as dividend; company-level buyback tax dropped.

title: Budget 2024: STCG 20%, LTCG 12.5%
description: STCG on listed equity 15%->20%; LTCG 10%->12.5%; exemption Rs 1L->Rs 1.25L. Sensex fell ~1.6% intraday but closed -0.09%.
notes: Same day as the STT and buyback items: treated as a confounded cluster.

title: Budget 2024: STT on F&O raised
description: STT futures 0.0125%->0.02%, options 0.0625%->0.1%, effective Oct 1, 2024.

title: Yen carry-trade unwind; global rout
description: Nikkei -12-13%; Sensex -2.74% to 78,768, Nifty ~24,055. Weak US jobs data and Middle East tension also cited.

title: Hindenburg alleges conflict at SEBI chair
description: Aug 12: Adani shares fell sharply (~$6.3B loss early); Nifty ~-143, Sensex ~-465 in early trade. Buch and Adani denied.
notes: Only early-session index figures sourced; claims unverified.

title: Fed cuts 50 bps to 4.75-5.00%
description: First cut since 2020. Sensex hit a record close of 83,185 and Nifty rose to 25,416 on Sep 19.

title: SEBI index-derivatives curbs announced
description: Six measures: one weekly-expiry benchmark per exchange, higher contract size, upfront premium, expiry-day margins. Phased Nov 2024 - Apr 2025.
notes: Sources disagree on circular date (Sep 30 vs Oct 1) and lot sizes; check SEBI circular.

title: Record DII buying: ~Rs 1.07 trn in October 2024
description: Record monthly DII inflow, offsetting FPI selling; start of a 25-month DII buying streak by Aug 2025.
notes: Counterweight node; same month as the FPI record. Monthly/structural aggregate: shown for context, not a dated shock, so it carries no measured impact and cannot be cut.

title: Record FPI outflow: Rs 94,017 cr in October 2024
description: Largest monthly FPI equity outflow at the time (prior record Rs 61,973 cr, Mar 2020), on cheaper Chinese stocks after stimulus.
notes: Monthly aggregate; event-study window is the month, not a single day. Monthly/structural aggregate: shown for context, not a dated shock, so it carries no measured impact and cannot be cut.

title: US indictment of Gautam Adani
description: Bribery/securities-fraud charges (~$250M solar contracts). Adani Enterprises -22.6%, Ports -13.6%; Nifty -0.72% to 23,350.

title: Fed cuts but signals only two 2025 cuts
description: Dec 19: Sensex -940 (-1.2%) to 79,243, fourth straight fall; fed funds 4.25-4.50%.

title: DeepSeek shock hits AI trade
description: Nvidia -17% (~$589B); Nifty IT -3.35%, though the broader Indian market ended firm.

title: Budget 2025: no tax up to Rs 12 lakh
description: Income-tax relief lifted consumption stocks but the index ended flat: Sensex +0.01%, Nifty -0.11% after a volatile session.

title: RBI cuts repo to 6.25%: first cut in ~5 years
description: 25 bps cut at Governor Malhotra's first MPC. Largely priced in; Nifty -0.18%.

title: Tariff crash after 'Liberation Day'
description: Sensex -2,227 (-2.95%) to 73,138, Nifty -3.24% to 22,162; India VIX +56%; Nikkei ~-9% at open. Tariffs announced Apr 2-3.
notes: Announcement was Apr 2-3; Apr 7 is the largest market reaction day.

title: RBI cuts repo to 6.00%, stance to accommodative
description: Second cut of 2025. Market fell anyway on tariff worries: Sensex -380 to 73,847, Nifty -137 to 22,399.
notes: Confounded with Apr 2025 tariff turmoil.

title: Pahalgam attack; LoC ceasefire violations follow
description: Attack day barely moved Nifty (+0.17%); the real hit was Apr 25 when LoC ceasefire violations dragged Sensex ~1,075-1,195 pts intraday (close -0.71%, Nifty -0.86%).
notes: Reaction numbers for Apr 22-23 come from a secondary blog; confounded with Apr 2025 tariff rebound.

title: Operation Sindoor: India strikes Pakistan
description: Sensex opened ~-692 but recovered to -0.19% (80,641); Nifty -0.33% (24,380); PSX fell ~6%; defence stocks firm. Close figures differ slightly by source.
notes: Cluster with Pahalgam and the May 10 truce.

title: India-Pakistan stop-firing understanding
description: Understanding on stopping firing reached; Nifty closed 24,925 on May 12 (~+4%), helped by a US-China tariff pause.
notes: Confounded with US-China tariff pause (May 12). Event date inferred as the weekend before; confirm.

title: RBI cuts repo 50 bps to 5.50%, CRR by 100 bps
description: Surprise 50 bps cut (cumulative 100 bps since Feb); CRR 4%->3% in four tranches from Sep 6, releasing ~Rs 2.5 lakh crore.

title: Israel strikes Iran (Operation Rising Lion)
description: Israel struck Iranian nuclear and military sites; Iran retaliated; truce took effect ~Jun 23.
notes: Event is primary-sourced (Israel's UN letter); Indian index reaction NOT yet sourced.

title: SEBI bars Jane Street, impounds Rs 4,844 cr
description: Interim order alleging Bank Nifty manipulation; BSE shares fell up to ~6%. Index reaction not sourced.

title: India-UK trade agreement (CETA) signed
description: Duty-free access for ~99% of Indian exports to the UK. Jul 24 Sensex +0.66% to 82,727; Jul 25 Sensex -721 as autos/energy fell.
notes: Falls the week of the Jul 30 US tariff announcement: confounded.

title: Trump announces 25% tariff on India (from Aug 1)
description: Jul 31: Sensex -296 to 81,186, Nifty -87 to 24,768; rupee at five-month low ~87.7. Market read it as a pressure tactic.
notes: Precedes the Aug 6 Russian-oil penalty: confounded cluster.

title: US adds 25% Russian-oil penalty: 50% on India
description: Executive order adds 25% on India for Russian oil, effective Aug 27, taking the total to 50%.
notes: Index reaction not sourced yet.

title: S&P upgrades India to BBB (first in 18 years)
description: BBB- to BBB, stable outlook. Aug 14 Sensex +0.07%; Aug 18 Sensex +1,168 intraday high, also on GST reform hints in the Independence Day speech.
notes: Positive node. Confounded with Aug 15 GST announcement and the Aug 6 tariff penalty.

title: US trade team's Aug 25-29 Delhi visit called off
description: Sixth round of trade-deal talks cancelled/deferred after the extra 25% tariff; no new dates.
notes: Date inferred from report timestamps; Reuters could not verify at the time. Index reaction not sourced.

title: NSE/BSE weekly expiry days swapped to Tuesday/Thursday
description: Under SEBI's late-May 2025 circular all equity-derivative expiries must fall on Tue or Thu; NSE moved Thu->Tue, BSE Tue->Thu effective Sep 1. Aims to curb expiry-day speculation.
notes: Date is the effective date; circular date (late May) not pinned down. Index reaction not sourced.

title: GST Council approves 5%/18% two-slab structure
description: 56th meeting: 12%/28% slabs largely merged into 5%/18% plus 40% sin rate, effective Sep 22.
notes: Index reaction not sourced yet.

title: Fed cuts 25 bps to 4.00-4.25%
description: First cut in nine months, two more projected. Sep 18: Sensex +320 to 83,014, Nifty +93 to 25,424, India VIX <10.

title: US $100,000 H-1B fee proclamation
description: Nifty IT -2.95% to 25,550 on Sep 22, steepest fall since Apr 3; fee applies to new petitions only.

title: US sanctions Rosneft and Lukoil
description: Brent +4.8% to $65.57 on Oct 23; Reliance cut Russian imports ~24% in October; wind-down period to Nov 21. Index reaction not sourced.
notes: Sanctions date and scope from the US Treasury release (primary); Brent/Reliance figures from press. Indian index reaction not sourced.

title: Fed cuts 25 bps; Powell: December cut 'far from' certain
description: Fed funds 3.75-4.00% (10-2 vote). Oct 30: Sensex -0.70% to 84,404, Nifty -0.68% to 25,878 (reaction reported separately; sources do not tie it to the Fed).
notes: Index figures from a separate 5paisa live blog.

title: Rupee breaches 90/USD for the first time
description: Settled ~90.21 on FPI outflows, crude and trade-deal uncertainty; Sensex -31 to 85,107, a fourth straight fall.
notes: Confounded with the Dec 5 RBI cut.

title: RBI cuts repo 25 bps to 5.25%
description: Unexpected cut; Sensex +447 to 85,712, Nifty +0.59% to 26,186; PSU banks +1.5%.

title: Fed cuts 25 bps to 3.50-3.75%, hints at pause
description: Dec 11: Sensex +427 (+0.51%) to 84,818, Nifty +0.55% to 25,899; Dec 12 Sensex +450 to 85,268. Rupee hit ~90.56 amid FPI selling.
notes: Overlaps the Dec 5 RBI cut and the rupee break.

title: India-EU FTA concluded after 18 years
description: Cuts EU tariffs on ~99% of Indian exports; phased car-duty cuts. Jan 27 Nifty +0.51% to 25,175; Jan 28 Sensex +487; autos weak.
notes: Terms are as reported, not treaty text.

title: January 2026: FPI exodus, worst January in a decade
description: Nifty hit 26,340 on Jan 2, then both indices fell >3% in January on FPI outflows, weak earnings and rupee pressure; ~Rs 16 trn m-cap lost.
notes: Monthly aggregate; ends right before the Feb 1 Budget. Monthly/structural aggregate: shown for context, not a dated shock, so it carries no measured impact and cannot be cut.

title: Budget 2026: STT hiked on F&O
description: Futures STT 0.02%->0.05%, options premium 0.10%->0.15%, effective Apr 1. Nifty -1.96% to 24,825, Sensex -1.88%; worst Budget day since 2020; India VIX +12%.

title: India-US trade deal; US tariff cut to 18%
description: Announced after Trump-Modi call. Nifty closed 25,728 (~+2.5%, intraday high 26,341), rupee +1%. Starting tariff base reported inconsistently (50% vs 25%).
notes: Positive node: cutting it should lower the counterfactual. Terms not detailed by either government at announcement.

title: Nifty IT -5.87% on Anthropic Claude Cowork fears
description: Worst IT day since Mar 2020, all 10 constituents down; index ~-19% from Feb 3 peak within eight sessions.

title: US Supreme Court strikes down IEEPA tariffs
description: 6-3 ruling; Trump moved to a temporary 10% global tariff (Section 122). Feb 23: Sensex +480 to 83,295, Nifty +142 to 25,713; India delayed trade talks.
notes: Positive for India's tariff burden. Friday close was after Indian hours.

title: Nifty IT -4% as AI fears extend
description: Second leg of the IT selloff, tied by press to a new Claude agent launch and a viral Citrini Research report.
notes: Within 20 trading days of Feb 4: confounded cluster.

title: US-Iran conflict: Hormuz disruption, gap-down open
description: US-Israeli strikes on Iran began Feb 28 (weekend); Mar 2 open: Sensex -3.4% intraday, Nifty ~-2.1%, oil +7% to ~$82, rupee ~91.2 as Hormuz navigation was closed. Nifty closed 22,512 on Mar 23.
notes: Strike date from press (weekend before the Mar 2 open); monthly decline is an outcome, not a separate event.

title: Record March 2026 FPI outflow: ~Rs 1.18 trn
description: Highest monthly FPI outflow on record amid the West Asia crisis; FY26 FPI net outflow ~Rs 1.8 trn, largest since 1992.
notes: Monthly aggregate. Overlaps the US-Iran node: confounded. Monthly/structural aggregate: shown for context, not a dated shock, so it carries no measured impact and cannot be cut.

title: India's MSCI EM weight falls to ~12% as Taiwan and Korea surge on AI chips
description: India's weight fell from ~20-21% (mid/Sep 2024) to ~11-12% (May 2026), from #2 to #4 behind Taiwan, China and Korea; attributed to AI-semiconductor exposure India lacks.
notes: Slow-moving structural trend, not a day-shock; use as an annotation rather than an event-study node. Exact weights differ between sources (UPSC explainers vs State Street); confirm from MSCI factsheets. Replaces the unverified 1.73x->1.30x premium seed. Monthly/structural aggregate: shown for context, not a dated shock, so it carries no measured impact and cannot be cut.

title: Accenture narrows FY26 outlook, bookings weak: Nifty IT ~-6%
description: Accenture's Q3 FY26 results (Jun 18): FY26 revenue growth narrowed to 3-4% in local currency, bookings -2% y/y. Press reports Nifty IT fell nearly 6% on Jun 19 (Infosys -8%, TCS -6%).
notes: Results/outlook from Accenture's own release (primary); the Indian IT move is from a secondary report and the Jun 19 close is unconfirmed.

title: Brent tops $100 again (Red Sea tanker attacks)
description: Nifty opened ~0.85% lower at ~23,666 as Brent crossed $100 on attacks on Saudi tankers.
notes: Only the open is sourced; confirm the close.

title: Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act signed
description: Signed after 86-11 Senate and 262-159 House votes; allows tariffs up to 100% on top buyers of Russian oil/gas (India, China exposed). Some reports say Sep 19.
notes: Signed Sep 18 per the White House date (some outlets say Sep 19). Law is named after the late Sen. Lindsey Graham. Market reaction not sourced.
